key_insight: An attention-fused TFT–N-BEATS model combines short-term dynamics with long-term patterns for unified PV power forecasting across five horizons.
engineering_relevance: More accurate multi-horizon forecasts could support grid scheduling and coordinated PV–battery operation; this study addresses forecasting, not solar-cell materials.
method: TFT learns short-term dependencies and dynamic feature importance.
N-BEATS decomposes long-term trends and seasonality.
Adaptive attention fuses both branches for 30-minute to 24-hour forecasts.
evidence_signal: On multi-year DKASC datasets, the abstract reports RMSE values of 42.35–52.29, a 35–40% reduction versus TFT, and MAPE below 5% across all datasets.
watch_item: The abstract does not specify RMSE units or temporal validation details, limiting assessment of operational accuracy and generalization.
paper_title: A Hybrid TFT-NBEATS Framework for Robust Multi-Horizon Photovoltaic Power Forecasting
